sql: SELECT T1.pos, T1.award, T2.nameGiven, T2.lastName FROM AwardsPlayers T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T1.pos=(SELECT pos FROM AwardsPlayers WHERE pos IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pos ORDER BY COUNT(award) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY T1.year DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(oppID) OVER (), tmID, oppID FROM TeamVsTeam WHERE year=1915 AND tmID=(SELECT tmID FROM Teams WHERE year=1915 ORDER BY W DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT T1.rank, T1.year, T1.name FROM Teams T1 JOIN Scoring T2 ON T1.tmID=T2.tmID AND T1.year=T2.year WHERE T2.SHA>=7 ORDER BY T2.A DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T3.name FROM Teams T1 JOIN TeamVsTeam T2 ON T1.tmID=T2.tmID AND T1.year=T2.year JOIN Teams T3 ON T2.oppID=T3.tmID AND T2.year=T3.year WHERE T1.year=2000 AND T1.name='Buffalo Sabres' GROUP BY T3.name ORDER BY SUM(T2.W+T2.L+IFNULL(T2.T,0)+IFNULL(T2.OTL,0)) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.PIM FROM TeamsSC T1 JOIN Teams T2 ON T1.tmID=T2.tmID AND T1.year=T2.year WHERE T2.name='Montreal Canadiens' AND T1.year=1918
SELECT SUM(CAST(T1.W AS REAL)/T1.G)/COUNT(T1.tmID) FROM TeamsSC T1 JOIN Teams T2 ON T1.tmID=T2.tmID AND T1.year=T2.year WHERE T2.name='Montreal Canadiens'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T2.tmID='BOS' AND T2.year=1972 AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL AND T1.hofID IS NULL

SELECT T2.firstName, T2.lastName FROM Goalies T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID JOIN Teams T3 ON T1.tmID=T3.tmID AND T1.year=T3.year WHERE T3.name='Minnesota North Stars' GROUP BY T1.playerID ORDER BY SUM(T1.GA) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year=2005 THEN T1.GP ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year=2006 THEN T1.GP ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100/SUM(CASE WHEN T1.year=2005 THEN T1.GP ELSE 0 END) FROM Goalies T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T2.firstName='David' AND T2.lastName='Aebischer'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.coachID FROM Master T1 JOIN AwardsCoaches T2 ON T1.coachID=T2.coachID WHERE T1.playerID IS NULL AND T1.coachID IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(T1.Pts), T2.coachID FROM Teams T1 JOIN Coaches T2 ON T1.tmID=T2.tmID AND T1.year=T2.year WHERE T1.tmID='ANA' GROUP BY T2.coachID

SELECT DISTINCT T1.playerID, T1.tmID FROM Scoring T1 WHERE T1.year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1936 AND T1.playerID=(SELECT T2.playerID FROM Master T2 JOIN Scoring T3 ON T2.playerID=T3.playerID WHERE T3.year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1936 AND T2.height IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(T2.height AS INT) ASC LIMIT 1)
SELECT CAST(T1.W AS REAL)/T1.G, T2.playerID FROM Teams T1 JOIN Scoring T2 ON T1.tmID=T2.tmID AND T1.year=T2.year WHERE T1.year=1998 AND T1.tmID='CAR' ORDER BY T2.G DESC LIMIT 1
